remarks: Welcome to 1011 Stillwater Road, a charming Colonial that perfectly blends classic character with everyday comfort. Nestled in one of Stamford's most convenient neighborhoods, this inviting home welcomes you with timeless curb appeal and an abundance of natural light throughout. The main level features a warm & spacious living room with a cozy fireplace, ideal for relaxing evenings or hosting guests. Just off the living area, a delightful sunroom offers a peaceful retreat for morning coffee, reading, or simply soaking in the sunlight year-round. The kitchen provides plenty of space for meal prep & creativity, flowing easily into the dining area that's perfect for gatherings with friends & family. Upstairs, you'll find comfortable bedrooms with ample closet space and a full bath that serves the space with ease. The lower level provides additional storage options or potential for future customization. Step outside to enjoy the lush, private backyard, a great spot for outdoor dining, gardening, or summer get-togethers. With easy access to local shops, restaurants, schools, and major commuter routes, this home offers a wonderful blend of charm, convenience & opportunity in the heart of Stamford.
